notes.title: Early Access Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]My Card Is Better Than Your Card! will be coming to Steam Early Access on October 6th, 2025! 🐸⭐
[/h1][previewyoutube="3L02RMI8Pmc;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Just two more weeks to our Early Access release! Please check out our new trailer above. A huge thanks to everyone who have supported us by playing our demo, providing us with feedback and participating in our playtests!⭐ [/p]

notes.title: Demo update Jun 14
notes.notes:
[p]We made the following changes to the demo! All stickers should be able to be added to Collections. Please note that for a sticker to be added into your Collection, the sticker needs to be in your deck, on a card, at the run's end. Happy collecting! 🐸

[h2]Stickers[/h2]

[list]
[*] Changed Bug sticker drop chances so they can be added to Collections 
[*] Changed holo Star drop chance so it can be added to Collections
[/list]

[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 10
notes.notes:

[h1]General[/h1][list][*][p]Cards have a button to clear stickers during crafting[/p][/*][/list][h1]Events[/h1][list][*][p]Flea Market now has coin icon next to the cost[/p][/*][/list][h1]Stickers[/h1][list][*][p]Stickers have better tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]BlackHole now removes 4 random stars (up from 2)[/p][/*][*][p]Small drop rate reduction to stickers with card draw[/p][/*][/list][h1]Misc[/h1][list][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 9
notes.notes:
We made the following changes to the demo! Thanks to everyone for playing and giving us feedback, it has helped us a ton! 🐸

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reward Screen now has animation that displays coins gained from Treasure tokens
[*] Starter Packs
[*] Replaced ShootingStar with Stardust in star starter pack
[/list]
[h1]Stickers[/h1]
[list]
[*] ShootingStar now gives 4 stars (up from 2)
[*] Walrus now removes 3 candy (up from 2)
[*] Sunglasses now removes 3 stars (up from 2)
[*] Increased Dragon and Crocodile holographic drop rate
[/list]
[h1]Tokens[/h1]
[list]
[*] Casette tokens now convert faster into MusicNote tokens
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 6
notes.notes:
[p]We made the following updates to the demo. Thanks to everyone for trying it out, and giving us feedback and bug reports. If you find any issues, please let us know either here in Steam Communities section or by joining our [url="https://discord.gg/EnZhajj8D4"]Discord[/url]! 🥰 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sticker collection view. Stickers from your deck will be added to your sticker collection after your runs!
[/list]
[h1]Opponents[/h1]
[list]
[*]The opponents will sometimes have things to say at the beginning and end of a card battle
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*]New animations between events
[*]Localization fixes
[*]Bug fixes
[*]We added more bugs (the cute ones 🪲)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 4
notes.notes:
We made the following updates to the demo, thanks to everyone for trying out the demo, and giving us feedback and bug reports!

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Sticker tooltips in different events now display information about keywords
[*] You can now view your deck when the run ends
[*] CATCH FISH - has a new visual feedback
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 2
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for playing the demo, we made some changes based on player feedback! Let us know what you think about the changes in our [url=https://discord.gg/EnZhajj8D4]Discord[/url] or here in the community forums. 

[h1]Events[/h1]
[list]
[*] You will now get one event more each day
[/list]
[h3]Treasure Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't give coins anymore but you earn more from card battles
[/list]
[h3]Recycling Center[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now recycle up to 3 cards during this event
[*] You no longer get to keep the stickers from recycled cards
[/list]
[h1]Stickers[/h1]
[list]
[*] General drop rate adjustments
[/list]
[h3]Fishing Rod[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now rolls separately for each fish
[/list]
[h3]Octopus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Look 3 (down from 4) to draw 1 (down from 2)
[/list]
[h1]Starter Packs[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2 new Starter Packs
[*] Bug deck now uses the Bug Container item
[*] First new starter pack is unlocked faster than before
[/list]
[h1]Opponents[/h1]
[list]
[*] All new opponent decks
[*] Opponent decks evolve day by day
[*] The choices are more varied who to card battle
[*] They are smarter
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo release date: May 29th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/312198a44a77204c66511d6c6dfedb4367998850.png[/img]

Mark your calendars! "My Card Is Better Than Your Card!" will be live on Steam on May 29th. Just little over two weeks! We are very excited to see how what kind of cards everyone will make. Very eager to hear everyone's thoughts & feedback on the demo after playing it! 🐸

Please consider wishlisting the game so you won't miss when the demo goes live!
